diagnosis.summary: The original cloud transcript contains 30 real web_search tool executions and returns in the r2 revision window (lines 2212–2274, 2026-11-20 11:03:19–11:03:55 Asia/Shanghai). Every one of the 31 unknown claims has its recorded select URL appearing in those tool results (30 exact URL matches; one Wikisource URL is exact in the result chunk but had been split by a parenthesis in a naive URL regex). Two claims share one search because they share the same Library of Congress URL. The nature-claim UN members URL is not from a new r2 search; it is the r1 archived page, itself backed by a r1 web_search at line 2140. The r2 zip did not pack a search log or these tool returns, even though the cloud assistant noted that a search-log JSON would be written into audit. The earlier r2 QA correctly refused to treat select.executed=true as proof when only the package was available. With this dump, the missing piece is an in-package (or attached) audit trail, not the absence of historical execution.
diagnosis.what_is_not_execution: Assistant thinking, the 2276 prose “检索已经做完”, and the package fields select.executed / select.query / select.outcome are not themselves tool records. They were not used as proof except where a tool result URL independently matches.
